Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; authentication, least privilege, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Data quality is yellow for analytics source permissions or collector errors. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and do not approve security-sensitive release or public exposure. Allow only bounded, reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing consent, disclosure, provenance, and claims boundaries. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, exploit targets, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.
